metadata.title: Alertbox.org | Open-Source & Private Donation Alerts
metadata.description: Alertbox.org is a free, open-source alert box creator for streamers. Enjoy custom profiles, zero platform fees, and total privacy. Powered by Stripe, Ko-fi, and Buy Me a Coffee.

index.title: Stream Freely. Donate Privately.
index.description: The real-time donation alert box built for viewer anonymity. Let your fans support your stream without revealing who they are.

footer.description:
Alertbox.org is an open-source alert box service featuring custom streamer profiles, zero platform fees, and robust privacy protection. 
Powered by trusted payment gateways like Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, and Stripe.
